newsitem.title: USA: NeXstar, Schering AG extend R&D agreement.
newsitem.headline: NeXstar, Schering AG extend R&D agreement.

text.p: NeXstar Pharmaceuticals Inc said on Thursday Schering AG extended a research and development collaboration with NeXstar to create in vivo imaging agents and boosted its annual research payments.
Schering increased its research payments to $2.4 million per year from $1 million, NeXstar said.

Under the terms of the pact, NeXstar used its SELEX combinatorial chemistry process to develop so-called aptamers, or short stretches of modified DNA or RNA. These aptamers bind to certain targets in the body and could be detected by imaging techniques.
The original collaboration, signed in 1993, also included milestone payments and a royalty provision for each in vivo imaging agent developed under the collaboration.
